class.name: FmodDspSettings
class.brief_description: The DSP buffer settings FMOD's mixer uses, read from Project Settings.
class.description: Set in Project Settings under [code]Fmod/DSP[/code], and applied by [method FmodServer.set_system_dsp_buffer_size]. Smaller buffers lower the audio latency and raise the CPU cost, and too small a buffer makes the sound stutter.

members.member: The number of DSP buffers FMOD's mixer cycles through.
The length of each DSP buffer, in samples.
